bass.tags: Indie rock with post-punk and surf rock influences. Clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated eighth-note riff using a bright, bridge-pickup tone with light spring reverb. A second electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with occasional slides and palm-muted accents. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar progression in a steady driving rhythm. Drums feature a prominent, dry snare and a consistent hi-hat pattern with occasional open hi-hat accents on the off-beats. The tempo is 145 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is centered around a cyclical chord progression that shifts between a bright major tonality and a more driving, rhythmic bridge section.
